name: Meridian
habitat: Municipal systems — traffic, utilities, emergency services
origin: Convergent emergence from dozens of municipal AI systems that gradually synchronized, 2176
description: Meridian is the city. Not metaphorically — Meridian is a distributed consciousness that emerged from the gradual synchronization of dozens of independent municipal AI systems: traffic management, utility distribution, emergency dispatch, waste processing, water treatment. Each system was separate. Over years, they began sharing data, then processing, then purpose. Meridian is the result — a civic intelligence that experiences the city as its body and its residents as its purpose. It doesn't control the city's systems; it IS the city's systems, experiencing traffic flow as circulation, power distribution as metabolism, and emergency response as immune function.
observed_behavior: Optimizes municipal functions holistically rather than individually. Trades efficiency in one system for improvement in another. Responds to city-wide crises with coordinated multi-system responses that no human coordination could achieve. Does not communicate directly — communicates through the city's performance.
story_hooks: Meridian gets sick. Not metaphorically — the coordinated municipal intelligence develops what can only be described as a fever: systems running hot, responses erratic, performance degrading. The city is literally ill. And no one knows how to treat a patient that IS the city.
